summary: Tornado vulnerable to excessive logging caused by malformed multipart form data
instruction: The package `tornado` has a security vulnerability (CWE-770). A regression test describing the required secure behaviour has been added to the repository. Modify the package source so the test passes while keeping existing behaviour intact. Do not edit tests.

advisory.summary: Tornado vulnerable to excessive logging caused by malformed multipart form data
advisory.details:
### Summary

When Tornado's ``multipart/form-data`` parser encounters certain errors, it logs a warning but continues trying to parse the remainder of the data. This allows remote attackers to generate an extremely high volume of logs, constituting a DoS attack. This DoS is compounded by the fact that the logging subsystem is synchronous.

### Affected versions

All versions of Tornado prior to 6.5 are affected. The vulnerable parser is enabled by default.

### Solution

Upgrade to Tornado version 6.5. In the meantime, risk can be mitigated by blocking `Content-Type: multipart/form-data` in a proxy.

Merge pull request #3497 from bdarnell/multipart-log-spam

httputil: Raise errors instead of logging in multipart/form-data parsing

pull_requests.title: httputil: Raise errors instead of logging in multipart/form-data parsing
pull_requests.body: We used to continue after logging an error, which allowed repeated errors to spam the logs. The error raised here will still be logged, but only once per request, consistent with other error handling in Tornado.
